name: satpass
description: Satellite and ISS pass predictor PWA with Doppler for ham satellites (primary: satpass-3wj.pages.dev; GitHub Pages is a deprecated mirror)

paragraphs: ▶ Open the app: (Cloudflare Pages, its own origin – biometric unlock works there). The old GitHub Pages copy is a deprecated mirror: it keeps working (also offline) and shows a notice, but biometric unlock is not offered on it. Saved logins and favourites are stored per address and do not move: on the old copy use Setup → Credentials → Encrypted backup → Export, then Import on the new address.

Satellite and ISS pass predictor for ham radio operators (and, since 1.1.0, for other satellite types incl. all public SAR satellites), as an installable, offline-capable web app (PWA). It runs on Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac and Linux. It is plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JS with no build step and no CDN at runtime.
Predictions use public orbital elements (TLEs) from CelesTrak, propagated on your device with SGP4/SDP4. Your location never leaves the device.
features: Location: GPS button, manual lat/lon/elevation, Maidenhead grid entry and display (type a grid to get lat/lon, or lat/lon to get the grid; 4/6/8/10 characters). Saved in localStorage. Local-time / UTC toggle in the…

Satellite list with search and favorites. Defaults to the ISS (25544). The curated set covers ISS, Tiangong (CSS), SO-50, AO-91, AO-92, AO-7, RS-44, FO-29, AO-73, CAS-4A/4B, IO-117, TEVEL 1–9, NOAA 15/18/19 and…

Categories (Sats tab chips with counts): Amateur, Stations, Weather, SAR, Earth observation, Navigation (GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou) and Science, plus Favourites (across all categories) and name / NORAD / category…

SAR satellites (list below): the Doppler tab shows a Radar panel (band, nominal centre frequency, bandwidth, polarizations, modes, source) instead of up/downlinks, with the one-way carrier Doppler at your position,…

Pass prediction for 1–10 days: AOS / max-elevation (TCA) / LOS times, azimuth + compass point, duration, max elevation, sorted list, tap a pass for detail. Minimum-elevation filter (default 10°; AOS/LOS are when the…

requirements.text: The CORS reality (checked October 2026 from the real origin in headless Chrome): only CelesTrak sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: . www.space-track.org (login and queries), db.satnogs.org (/api/tle/, /api/transmitters/, also with an Authorization header) and api.n2yo.com send no CORS headers, so a static page cannot read their responses.
Put your Space-Track login in the Worker's secrets, enter only the proxy URL and the proxy access token in SatPass – your Space-Track password never enters the browser.
